units.source_text: 笔致流畅活泼，一气呵成，书体特别艳丽。

en.t: The brushwork was fluent and lively, written in one breath, and the script was especially elegant.

units.source_text: 大女公子寻思：“若把此人当作外客看，确是个风流人物。

en.t: The elder princess thought, "If one looked on this man as an outside guest, he was certainly a charming and refined figure.

units.source_text: 但今已是我妹夫，却要担心他日后如何了。”

en.t: But now that he is my younger sister's husband, I must worry about what will become of him."

units.source_text: 她觉得此时自告奋勇代为作复，甚不相宜，就认真地教导妹妹，强要她亲自作复。

en.t: She felt it would be quite improper at this point to volunteer to write the reply for her, so she earnestly instructed her sister and insisted that she answer in her own hand.

units.source_text: 犒赏使者的是紫菀色女装褂子一件，又添三重裙一条。

en.t: The reward for the messenger was a woman's jacket in aster purple, with a three-layered skirt added as well.

units.source_text: 使者不悉内情，受赐甚觉狼狈，便把衣服包好，交随从人拿了。

en.t: The messenger, not knowing the circumstances, felt very awkward receiving the gift, so he wrapped up the clothes and handed them to an attendant to carry.

units.source_text: 这使者不是公然出差的人，乃是过去常到宇治送信的一个殿上童子。

en.t: This messenger was not someone sent openly on official business, but a court page who had often gone to Uji in the past to deliver letters.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不欲使外人知道，所以特地派遣此人。

en.t: Prince Niou did not want outsiders to know, and so he had deliberately sent this man.

units.source_text: 他推想这犒赏定是那个好事的老侍女所为，心中颇感不快。

en.t: He supposed that this reward must have been arranged by that meddlesome old gentlewoman, and he felt rather displeased.
